full_workload_reports.freshness: CLI resolves CURRENT and DLOG on every call. Session pins both once and keeps the full graph and indexes in RAM until exit.
full_workload_reports.scope: Fresh CLI startup/admission/evaluation/full stdout versus already-open snapshot JSONL request/evaluation/full stdout. OS cache retained. full_workload_reports.validation: Every full ordered answer, including warmups, equals independent generated JSON with exact RDF term fields, variable headers, multiplicities and row positions.

limit_zero_after_shortcut.freshness: CLI resolves CURRENT and DLOG on every call. Session pins both once and keeps the full graph and indexes in RAM until exit.
limit_zero_after_shortcut.scope: Fresh CLI startup/admission/evaluation/full stdout versus already-open snapshot JSONL request/evaluation/full stdout. OS cache retained. One warmup per workload per mode; alternating order. Parse/validation and output-file writes are outside timing. Session admission/indexing measured separately. No competitor timings.
limit_zero_after_shortcut.validation: Every full ordered answer, including warmups, equals independent generated JSON with exact RDF term fields, variable headers, multiplicities and row positions.

scope: Native synthetic snapshot reuse versus fresh admission. Different freshness/memory models; no competitor or industry-parity claim.
